contradictions.what: Rep named Maya as final decider, then conceded Greg decided whether anyone got chosen.
Maya said it was her call, but the contract sat with Greg for two weeks and he signed.
Rep said Maya was in every meeting and ran things, yet the key moment was silent Greg's request.
